en.text: HKDSE 2012 Paper 1 Q18

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2012 卷一 第 18 題

en.text: The market structure of the electric power industry in Hong Kong is

zh.text: 香港電力行業的市場結構屬

en.text: an oligopoly because there are two dominating companies in the market.

zh.text: 寡頭壟斷，因爲市場上有兩間具支配力的公司。

en.text: an oligopoly because the pricing strategies of the companies are interdependent.

zh.text: 寡頭壟斷，因爲各公司的訂價策略互相影響。

en.text: a monopoly because the companies can increase the price without losing customers.

zh.text: 壟斷，因爲各公司可提高價格而不會流失顧客。

en.text: a monopoly because there is only one electric company providing electricity in any district.

zh.text: 壟斷，因爲在任何地區只有一間電力公司提供電力。

en.text: HKDSE 2013 Paper 1 Q17

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2013 卷一 第 17 題

en.text: The table below shows the distribution of market share of supermarkets in Hong Kong in 2012.

zh.text: 下表顯示 2012 年香港超級市場的市場份額的分佈。

en.text: Name

zh.text: 名稱

en.text: Market share (%)

zh.text: 市場份額 (%)

en.text: Wellcome

zh.text: 惠康

en.text: Parknshop

zh.text: 百佳

en.text: Vanguard

zh.text: 華潤萬家

en.text: Others

zh.text: 其他

en.text: Total

zh.text: 合共

en.text: From the above table, we can conclude that the market of supermarkets in Hong Kong is an example of ______ because ________.

zh.text: 我們可以由上表得出結論如下：香港超級市場是 ________ 市場的一個例子，因爲________。

en.text: oligopoly ... sellers are interdependent in their marketing strategies

zh.text: 寡頭壟斷……賣家的營銷策略互相影響

en.text: oligopoly ... a few major sellers are in control of the total sales of the market

zh.text: 寡頭壟斷……幾位主要賣家操控了市場的總銷售量

en.text: monopolistic competition ... sellers can affect the market price as their products are heterogeneous from the consumers' viewpoint

zh.text: 壟斷性競爭……賣家能影響市價，從消費者角度看來，它們的貨品是異質的

en.text: monopolistic competition ... there are many sellers adopting non-price competition in the market

zh.text: 壟斷性競爭……市場上有許多賣家採用非價格競爭

en.text: HKDSE 2014 Paper 1 Q17

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2014 卷一 第 17 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about the theme park industry in Hong Kong is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項有關香港主題公園行業的陳述是正確的？

en.text: Hong Kong Disneyland is a monopolist because its average cost of production drops when there are more tourists.

zh.text: 香港迪士尼樂園是一壟斷者，因為當遊客增加，它的平均生產成本下降。

en.text: Hong Kong Disneyland guarantees a profit because it is protected by the government.

zh.text: 香港迪士尼樂園保證能獲得利潤，因為它受政府保護。

en.text: Hong Kong Disneyland and Ocean Park Hong Kong have no competition with each other as tourists may go to both theme parks.

zh.text: 香港迪士尼樂園和香港海洋公園之間沒有競爭，因為遊客可能兩個主題公園皆到訪。

en.text: Hong Kong Disneyland and Ocean Park Hong Kong are interdependent in their marketing strategies.

zh.text: 香港迪士尼樂園和香港海洋公園的營銷策略是互相影響的。

en.text: HKDSE 2015 Paper 1 Q20

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 20 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about monopoly are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪些有關壟斷的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
A monopolist sets the market price.

zh.text: 壟斷者訂立市場價格。

en.text: A natural monopoly arises when no firms are permitted to enter the market.

zh.text: 當沒有廠商可獲准進入該市場，便會出現自然壟斷。

en.text: There are substitutes for the products provided by a monopolist.

zh.text: 壟斷者所提供的產品是有替代品的。

en.text: HKDSE 2016 Paper 1 Q20

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2016 卷一 第 20 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about monopolistic competition are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪些有關壟斷性競爭的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (3) only
(1) and (4) only
(2) and (3) only
(2) and (4) only
There can be a few or many buyers and sellers in the market.

zh.text: 市場內可以有小量或大量的買家和賣家。

en.text: The sellers are price searchers.

zh.text: 賣家屬尋價者。

en.text: The goods and services provided by the sellers are homogeneous.

zh.text: 賣家所提供的物品及服務屬同質的。

en.text: There are free entry and exit in the market.

zh.text: 該市場是自由進入和退出的。

en.text: HKDSE 2017 Paper 1 Q19

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2017 卷一 第 19 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about economies of scale is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項有關規模經濟的陳述是正確的？

en.text: It could be a source of monopoly power.

zh.text: 它可以是壟斷能力的來源。

en.text: It exists when the average fixed cost is falling.

zh.text: 當平均固定成本下降，規模經濟便會出現。

en.text: Only large firms enjoy economies of scale.

zh.text: 只有大型廠商才享有規模經濟。

en.text: It is the result of the law of diminishing marginal returns.

zh.text: 它是邊際回報遞減定律的結果。

en.text: HKDSE 2018 Paper 1 Q12

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 12 題

en.text: Sony’s PS4 was responsible for $17.8 billion of sales value, or 51% share of the global console hardware market, compared with Microsoft’s Xbox One at $9.1 billion of sales value or a 26% market share. Nintendo’s 3DS platform (and its variants, such as the 2DS) was a distant third on the list with $2.6 billion of sales value or 8% share of the market.

zh.text: 索尼的 PS4 的銷售額為 17.8 億元，在環球遊戲機硬件市場的佔有率為 51%。與其相比，微軟的 Xbox One 的銷售額為 9.1 億元，市場佔有率為 26%。任天堂的 3DS 平台 (及其他型號如 2DS) 則是遠遠落後的第三名，銷售額 2.6 億元，市場佔有率為 8%。

en.text: The market structure of the above global console hardware market is oligopoly. This statement is

zh.text: 上述環球遊戲機硬件市場的市場結構屬寡頭壟斷。這陳述

en.text: correct because the companies sell heterogeneous goods in the market.

zh.text: 是正確的，因為各公司在市場售賣異質物品。

en.text: correct because there are a few dominating companies in the market.

zh.text: 是正確的，因為市場有數家具支配力的公司。

en.text: incorrect because the PS4 was only responsible for 51% of the market.

zh.text: 是不正確的，因為 PS4 只佔市場的 51%。

en.text: incorrect because there are a lot of sellers in the global market.

zh.text: 是不正確的，因為環球市場有眾多賣家。

en.text: HKDSE 2018 Paper 1 Q21

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2018 卷一 第 21 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about a perfectly competitive market are correct?

zh.text: 下列哪些有關完全競爭市場的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
Firms cannot survive if they ask a price higher than the market price.

zh.text: 若廠商收取的價格高於市場價格，便不能生存。

en.text: There is no entry barrier to the market.

zh.text: 進入市場並沒有限制。

en.text: The profit-maximising condition of the firms is that price equals marginal cost.

zh.text: 廠商利潤極大化的條件為價格等於邊際成本。

en.text: HKDSE 2019 Paper 1 Q18

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2019 卷一 第 18 題

en.text: Alfred booked a room in a resort hotel. Later he found that Betty had booked a room in the same hotel at a lower price. Which of the following are possible reasons for such a price difference?

zh.text: 小明在一家渡假酒店預訂了一間房。後來他發現小欣在同一家酒店以較低價格預訂了一間房。下列哪些是這價格差異的可能原因？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
Alfred's booking was non-refundable while Betty's booking was with free cancellation.

zh.text: 小明的預訂屬不可退款，而小欣的預訂可免費取消。

en.text: Alfred booked the room in a weekend while Betty booked the room in a weekday.

zh.text: 小明預訂了週末的房間，而小欣預訂了平日的房間。

en.text: Alfred booked the room with sea view while Betty booked the room with street view.

zh.text: 小明預訂了海景房，而小欣預訂了街景房。

en.text: HKDSE 2020 Paper 1 Q10

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2020 卷一 第 10 題

en.text: Clothing retail market can be classified as monopolistic competition. Which of the following statements about clothing retail market are correct?

zh.text: 成衣零售市場可以歸類為壟斷性競爭。下列哪些有關成衣零售市場的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (3) only
(1) and (4) only
(2) and (3) only
(2) and (4) only
The retailers engage in both price and non-price competitions.

zh.text: 零售商進行價格和非價格競爭。

en.text: There are a few dominant sellers in the market.

zh.text: 市場上有數個具支配力的賣家。

en.text: There is imperfect information about the quality of clothing in the market.

zh.text: 市場上有關成衣質素的訊息並不完全。

en.text: The entry and exit of retailers are restricted.

zh.text: 零售商進入和退出該行業都受到限制。

en.text: HKDSE 2023 Paper 1 Q18

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2023 卷一 第 18 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about perfect competition is
INCORRECT

zh.text: 下列哪項關於完全競爭的陳述是不正確的？

en.text: The market price tends to be stable as no firm can affect the market price.

zh.text: 市場價格傾向穩定，因為沒有廠商能夠影響市場價格。

en.text: Price is the only competitive criterion in determining the distribution of goods.

zh.text: 價格是決定物品分配的唯一競爭準則。

en.text: The marginal cost of the last unit of all firms is equal when the firms maximise their profits.

zh.text: 當廠商利潤極大化時，所有廠商的最後一單位的邊際成本相等。

en.text: Firms sell homogeneous products.

zh.text: 廠商出售同質物品。

en.text: HKDSE 2024 Paper 1 Q18

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2024 卷一 第 18 題

en.text: The table below shows the market shares of top four subscription video-on-demand (SVoD) service providers worldwide in March 2024.

zh.text: 下表顯示全球四大訂閱制隨選影片服務供應商於2024年3月的市場佔有率。

zh.text: 訂閱制隨選影片服務供應商

zh.text: 市場佔有率(%)

zh.text: 網飛（Netflix）

en.text: Based on the above information, we can conclude that the market structure of the worldwide SVoD market in March 2024 could be regarded as ______ because ______.

zh.text: 根據以上資料，可得出的結論是：全球訂閱制隨選影片服務供應商市場於2024年3月的市場結構可被視為____，因為____。

en.text: monopolistic competition ... market information was imperfect

zh.text: 壟斷性競爭……市場資訊是不完全的

zh.text: 寡頭壟斷……不同國家的政府對服務供應商進入其市場有管控

en.text: HKDSE 2025 Paper 1 Q19

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2025 卷一 第 19 題

en.text: Firm X is a price-taking firm in a perfectly competitive market. Which of the following statements about Firm X are correct?

zh.text: 廠商 X 是完全競爭市場中的一間受價廠商。下列哪些有關廠商 X 的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (3) only
(2) and (3) only
Firm X engages in both price competition and non-price competition.

zh.text: 廠商 X 同時進行價格競爭及非價格競爭。

en.text: If Firm X increases its price of goods above the market price, it will lose all of its customers.

zh.text: 若廠商 X 將物品的價格提高至高於市場價格，它將失去所有顧客。

en.text: Customers cannot differentiate the goods sold by Firm X from those sold by other firms in the market.

zh.text: 顧客無法區別廠商 X 所售賣的物品與市場上其他廠商所售賣的物品。

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2026 卷一 第 19 題
